name: SISO Repo Bank
summary: The derived, queryable GitHub reuse banks exported read-only from the Foundry identity database: 23,778 rated repositories with category, capability tag and licence, 126 best-per-capability picks, 70 contract cards, adoption-versus-fame for 2,722 packages, the full 226,968-row placement table, a 56,674-repository star farm, and a scrubbed 3,010-row capability shelf.

evidence.summary: Public repository holds bank/ (nine JSONL tables plus repo_category.jsonl.gz), github-farm/, capability-shelf/ and prior-art/; head commit read via the GitHub API immediately before this record was written.

license.reason: The taxonomy, ratings, one-liners and indexes are SISO-authored and carry MIT; the repositories described keep their own licences, recorded per row.

evidence.summary: MIT license text is present at the exact release pin.

relationships.context: Curated under the Research section as the published projection of the Foundry's GitHub identity work.

evidence.summary: The README defines every table, its row count, how the values were produced and the query path for an agent.

relationships.context: Every bank table was exported from the Foundry identity SQLite (repo_card 1,358,200 rows) which stays unpublished under the Foundry dataset boundary.

evidence.summary: The Foundry dataset boundary keeps raw observations and SQLite snapshots out of Git and publishes derived banks with per-source rights gates.

relationships.context: bank_capability_top.jsonl is a first concrete answer shape for the best-primitive question: a ranked pick per capability with reuse value, licence and a one-line reason.

evidence.summary: 126 rows across 51 capabilities, e.g. auth-identity → panva/jose (reuse 88, MIT).

Tables were read with SQLite in read-only mode on 2026-09-05; md_path and agent_id columns were dropped; counts match the source: bank_best 23,778, bank_gold 29,940, bank_liftable_ranked 32,137, repo_category 226,968, category 264.
The star farm records its method (GraphQL keyset pagination), the seven tiers, expected versus collected rows per tier, and that no README bodies were fetched.
The capability shelf was published with client names replaced, and evidence_paths, intake_provenance and client_precedents removed; the remaining substring matches are GitHub usernames.
